title: Silver nanowire — nanowires
description: The silver nanowire is a 1D nanomaterial with diameter: 20–100 nm typical; transparent: studied for transparent conductive films. Fabrication route: polyol process. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
